name: saas-template
description: Full-stack SaaS template with React Router 7, Expo, and shared packages

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd web && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
scripts.build:ios: cd mobile && eas build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:android: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.submit:ios: cd mobile && eas build --platform ios --profile production --auto-submit
scripts.submit:android: cd mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production --auto-submit
scripts.build:ios:local: cd mobile && eas build --profile preview --local --platform ios
scripts.build:ios:local:dev: cd mobile && eas build --profile preview-dev --local --platform ios
scripts.build:android:local: cd mobile && eas build --profile preview --local --platform android
scripts.build:android:local:dev: cd mobile && eas build --profile preview-dev --local --platform android
scripts.typecheck: cd web && npm run typecheck && cd .. && npm run typecheck --workspace=mobile
scripts.check: npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
